content.value_statement: SurrealDB projects often need one guide for documents, graph traversal, vectors, and live queries. This skill gives Python-focused patterns for designing, querying, and tuning multi-model database features.
actual_capabilities: Shows async SurrealDB connection, authentication, namespace selection, and cleanup patterns.
Explains CRUD methods, merge updates, patch operations, upserts, deletes, and parameterized SurrealQL queries.
Models graph data with RELATE statements, traversal syntax, edge metadata, constraints, and indexes.
Guides vector storage, similarity search, hybrid retrieval, embedding choices, and RAG workflows.
Covers live query subscriptions for real-time application updates.
Provides reference guidance for schema design, performance tuning, and query safety.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not install, start, or administer a SurrealDB server.
Examples target SurrealDB 2.3.x and may need changes for other versions.
It does not manage production credentials, secrets, backups, or access policies.
Embedding providers and model packages may require separate installation, keys, and cost controls.

use_cases.title: Design Multi-Model Storage
use_cases.description: Plan document tables, graph relationships, vector fields, and indexes for one SurrealDB-backed service.

use_cases.title: Build Semantic Retrieval
use_cases.description: Create a Python RAG workflow that stores embeddings and retrieves relevant records with similarity search.

use_cases.title: Model Connected Knowledge
use_cases.description: Represent entities, edge metadata, recursive traversals, and recommendation paths with SurrealDB graph features.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Connection Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a SurrealDB Python connection plan. Include authentication, namespace selection, async cleanup, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design CRUD Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design CRUD operations for my SurrealDB table. Include create, merge, patch, upsert, delete, and safe parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Model a Graph Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to model my domain as a SurrealDB graph. Include RELATE statements, edge metadata, traversal queries, and indexes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a RAG Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a production RAG design with SurrealDB. Cover vector fields, embedding choices, hybrid search, graph filters, and live updates.

output_examples.input: Design a SurrealDB data model for authors, articles, citations, and semantic search.
output_examples.output: A schema plan with document tables, edge relationships, vector fields, useful indexes, and query safety notes.

output_examples.input: Help me add semantic search to an existing SurrealDB Python app.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step implementation outline for embeddings, storage, KNN retrieval, filtering, and result ranking.

output_examples.input: Review my graph traversal approach for performance risks.
output_examples.output: A focused review covering traversal depth, timeouts, indexes, duplicate edges, and safer query patterns.

best_practices: Parameterize SurrealQL queries and keep database credentials in a secret manager.
Define schemas, assertions, and indexes before moving SurrealDB workloads to production.
Benchmark embedding models, vector dimensions, and k values with realistic data.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse sample root credentials outside isolated local testing.
Do not concatenate user input into raw SurrealQL query strings.
Do not run recursive graph traversals without depth limits or timeouts.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build Python applications that use SurrealDB for documents, graphs, vectors, RAG, and live updates.

faq.question: Does it run SurrealDB for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and examples, but you must run and configure your own database.

faq.question: Can it help with vector search?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers embedding storage, KNN queries, similarity scoring, hybrid search, and RAG retrieval patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with graph relationships?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains RELATE statements, traversal syntax, edge tables, recursive paths, and relationship indexes.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production systems?
faq.answer: It includes production-oriented guidance, but you must add real credentials, access controls, monitoring, and backups.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
